# Gokulasigamani N

> Gokulasigamani N is a Full-Stack Developer based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, specializing in the MERN stack, AWS cloud architecture, and AI-powered automation.

Gokulasigamani N (also written Gokulasigamani, Gokul Asigamani) builds full-stack products end to end: frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure, and AI-driven automation. He co-founded an IT solutions company alongside client work.

This site (https://gokulasigamani.sunajo.com) is his personal portfolio and blog.
